The '''Great Vaults of Cato Neimoidia''',<ref name="Poe Dameron 20">[[Poe Dameron 20|''Poe Dameron'' 20]]</ref> also known as the '''Palace of Baron Paw Maccon''',<ref name="Poe Dameron 21" /> and formerly known as '''Lott Dod's palace''', was the personal residence of [[Senator]] [[Lott Dod]] of the [[Trade Federation]]. It was located on a [[bridge city]] on [[Cato Neimoidia]].<ref name="Senate Spy" /> Following Dod's [[death]] during the [[Clone Wars]], the palace was turned into a vault where individuals from all [[sector]]s across [[the galaxy]] kept some of their most precious possessions for safekeeping. In [[34 ABY]], [[Lor San Tekka]] was arrested after attempting to steal an [[Kazerath|artifact]] from one [[House Maccon]]'s vaults.<ref name="Poe Dameron 20" />

==History==
===Clone Wars===
During the [[Clone Wars]] in [[21 BBY]],<ref name="SW:GA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> the palace acted as the personal residence of [[Senator]] [[Lott Dod]] of the [[Trade Federation]], from where he conducted business and conspired with [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[warlord]] [[Poggle the Lesser]] and Senator [[Rush Clovis]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan|Banking Clan]] to invest in a [[Geonosis primary droid foundry|droid foundry]] on [[Geonosis]].<ref name="WFactory">{{TCW|Weapons Factory}}</ref>

In that [[Standard year|year]], Senators [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo]] and Rush Clovis of [[Scipio]] undertook a [[Mission to Cato Neimoidia|diplomatic mission]] to [[Cato Neimoidia]] where Dod allowed both her and the banker to stay at the palace. When Amidala was shown her quarters, Clovis was taken to the palace's [[library]] by Dod. There, they discussed with [[Archduke]] Poggle the Lesser about the Banking Clan's investment in [[Count]] [[Dooku]] 's new droid foundry and the benefits it would bring. However, Dod and Poggle demanded a greater share of the foundry's profits in their greed. When Clovis refused, the other two resolved to [[poison]]ing Amidala to coerce the banker to acquiesce to their demands. With the help of a disguised [[Anakin Skywalker]], Clovis confronted Dod and obtained the [[antidote]], though he was still left behind to talk with the Neimoidian, as a squad of [[B1-series battle droid]]s trained their blasters on him.<ref name="Senate Spy" />

===Cold war===
Dod later [[Death|died]] during the Clone Wars.<ref name="Poe Dameron 20" /> By [[34 ABY]],<ref name="34Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Poe Dameron 21|''Poe Dameron'' 21]] to [[34 ABY]].</ref> his palace was in the possession of [[Baron]] [[Paw Maccon]] of [[House Maccon]].<ref name="Poe Dameron 20" /> It was repurposed as a vault for the Neimoidians' wealthy clients, with its protection assured by a contingent of repainted [[B2-series super battle droid]]s, a squadron of [[Vulture-class starfighter|vulture droids]] and several [[Neimoidian Royal Guard]]s.

Baron Maccon attempted to persuade General [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] to store her mother's precious dresses in his Vaults, while unbeknownst to him agents of the [[Resistance]] infiltrated the palace to rescue [[Lor San Tekka]] from the baron's clutches.<ref name="Poe Dameron 21" />
